parameters.content:
## Add a client shop (/addshop)
Started by the Telegram bot when an admin sends **/addshop name.myshopify.com Client Name**.

The run pauses at **Wait for Claude Code: Add Shop**. A Claude Code session in the dtj-agency-automation folder (listening, or told "handle the Claude Code trigger in n8n") reads **Request for Claude Code: Add Shop**, runs add_shop.py (the seven app copies, the install service, the Install buttons in Telegram) and answers here. No theme or store change happens in this workflow: each install is a tap by someone logged in to that shop.

Source in git: `n8n/store-factory/` and `services/install-catcher/tools/add_shop.py`.
